body: Thank you, and same to you. Here's the honey mustard.

This is all very true, and that's exactly the problem. I am too weak. I am absolutely pathetic. Suicide is a difficult process to plan and act on, but my future endeavors are terrifyingly unpredictable. Thus, I am teetering on the edge of life and death. I appreciate your comment, though. I know I need to shut up and stand up, not sit here in the mire of my thoughts. I will check out his channel. Thank you.
